MissionSettings.Blurb: Mt. Cho is one of the strongest Liao positions on Carver V and is one of their primary reinforcement points. A base is built directly on top of the mountain, and is well defended by turret emplacements, vehicles, and 'Mechs. The surrounding areas are less well defended, but contain significant forces nonetheless.Your job is to go in and take out as many 'Mechs and vehicles as possible. If we can destroy enough of their fighting units, they won't be able to reinforce any other positions without calling for additional support from off-planet.  We estimate that in order to neutralize the threat, you'll have to eliminate at least 50% of the units in the area.I know this isn't an easy job, but I have faith that you'll be able to pull it off. Remember, the more units you can destroy now, the less we'll have to fight later. If we're ever going to get Liao off our planet, we have to start with Mt. Cho.
